predecessors.name: Lengyel culture
predecessors.text: Bohemia and central Poland, the Lengyel's northern extent

ledger.x: 4100 BCE: the Funnelbeaker farmers bring agriculture to the North European Plain and Scandinavia.
3300 BCE: the Globular Amphora culture replaces the eastern and southern Funnelbeaker groups.
2800 BCE: the Single Grave and Corded Ware cultures replace the Funnelbeaker.

certainty.note: An archaeological culture drawn by modern units: only the coasts are hard lines.
